explainer.title: What arrives and when
explainer.hint: The occasions and channels are below. A switch decides whether that occasion reaches you on that channel at all.

REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.name: Registration required
REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.when: Once, soon after you join an event whose registration is open, or after the organizer opens registration on an event you already joined. It carries the link and the deadline.

REGISTRATION_OVERDUE.name: The deadline has passed
REGISTRATION_OVERDUE.when: After the registration deadline, if you switched it on in your own reminder schedule. It arrives until the event ends.

REMINDER_REGISTRATION_DEADLINE.name: The registration deadline is near
REMINDER_REGISTRATION_DEADLINE.when: As many days before the deadline as you picked in your own reminder schedule. With no day picked, this reminder does not arrive.

REMINDER_EVENT_START.name: The event starts soon
REMINDER_EVENT_START.when: As many days before the event starts as you picked in your own reminder schedule. With no day picked, this reminder does not arrive.

REMINDER_STAGE_START.name: A stage starts soon
REMINDER_STAGE_START.when: As many days before a stage starts as you picked in your own reminder schedule. With no day picked, this reminder does not arrive.

REMINDER_EVENT_END.name: The event ends soon
REMINDER_EVENT_END.when: As many days before the event ends as you picked in your own reminder schedule. With no day picked, this reminder does not arrive.

WEEKLY_DIGEST.name: Weekly digest
WEEKLY_DIGEST.when: Once a week, when the week had something worth telling: upcoming registration deadlines, stages about to start and your own tasks falling due.

PERSONAL_TASK_DUE.name: A personal task is due
PERSONAL_TASK_DUE.when: Shortly before a task you set for yourself falls due. Organizers neither see these nor create them.

PERSONAL_RETROSPECTIVE_DUE.name: Time to look back
PERSONAL_RETROSPECTIVE_DUE.when: A couple of days after an event ends, so you can write down what you learned while it is fresh. Once per event.

explainer.allOffTitle: Every switch for this occasion is off
explainer.allOffHint: You chose not to receive this notification anywhere. This is separate from the channel list above: even if you later add a channel there, this occasion stays off until you switch it back on here.

card.title: Notification channels
card.emptyHint: You have no delivery route at all: nothing below can reach you until you pick at least one channel here, whatever its own switches say.

preview.title: Notification preview
preview.subtitle: The text this recipient would receive. Nothing is sent, queued or logged by opening this.
preview.noSideEffects: Preview only: no notification is created and nothing is scheduled.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.channelNotReadyHint: This recipient has neither a linked Telegram account nor a verified email, so this notification would end as undeliverable.
preview.nothingHint: This status has no notification to render: the event, the registration or the participation rules it out.

reminder.title: When to remind you
reminder.hint: You decide how many days of warning you get. The setting is yours and applies to every event you take part in; organizers do not affect it.
reminder.overdueTitle: Tell me about an overdue registration
reminder.overdueHint: When the registration deadline has passed and you have not marked yourself as registered. It arrives until the event ends.
reminder.emptyHint: No day is picked and overdue notices are off, so no deadline reminder will reach you. Other notifications are unaffected.
